_comment: One published jar per group, built from the group's first version (the lead). A version may only join a group
if (1) its own build compiles to classes byte-identical to the lead's (verifyGroupClasses) and (2) the scenario
test passes on it (runScenarioTest). Every member compiles at the lead's Java level so the comparison is exact.
The last group's jar declares '>=lead', so it keeps loading on newer Minecraft until a hook really breaks.
